settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: Delivery coverage and available shipping options are shown at checkout for your address in Pakistan.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order is dispatched, any tracking information available will be shared using the contact details provided at checkout.

settings.question: What payment methods can I use?
settings.answer: Available payment methods are displayed during checkout and may depend on your location and Shopify store settings.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange an item?
settings.answer: Please review our return and refund policy for current eligibility and instructions. Contact us before sending an item back.

settings.question: How do I get product help?
settings.answer: Use our contact page and include the product name and your question. We’ll do our best to help.
